rows.en:
(I wonder what the Galactic Fairy, Sheryl,
thinks of Ranka's talent?)
Sheryl, got a minute?

Oh, \p.
Do you need something from me?

In the Galactic Fairy's eyes,
how good is Ranka, really?

Ranka-chan's talent?
What, are you worried whether she'll make it?

There's no need to worry about that.
Ranka-chan has my seal of approval.
Her talent is the real deal.

Hearing that from the Galactic Fairy
would make Ranka really happy.

It's nothing.
I'll be taking my leave for today.

(I wonder what the Galactic Fairy, Sheryl,
thinks of Ranka-chan's talent?)
Sheryl-san, do you have a minute?

Oh, \p-chan.
Do you need something from me?

In the Galactic Fairy's eyes,
how good is Ranka-chan, really?

Hearing that from the Galactic Fairy
would make Ranka-chan really happy, right?

(Ranka-chan's really amazing, getting
recognized by the Galactic Fairy herself.)

(Come to think of it, Sheryl doesn't really
talk about her past much...)
Hey, Sheryl, got a minute?

Is there something you need
from me, \p?

I just had a question.
Sheryl, what were you like as a kid?

Were you always selfish and full of
yourself... I mean, were you always cute?
Um, Sheryl?

O-of course I was!
I've been as cute as an angel
since the day I was born!
Oh, so I was right.

I'm Sheryl, so of course I was!
Well, I have work soon, so I'll be going.

(Declaring flat out that she was cute as
an angel... Sheryl's really something...)
(But why did she look a little sad?)

(Come to think of it, Sheryl-san doesn't
really talk about her past much...)
Hey, Sheryl-san, got a minute?

Is there something you need
from me, \p-chan?

I just had a question.
Sheryl-san, what were you like as a kid?
Um, Sheryl-san?

(Declaring flat out that she was cute as
an angel... Sheryl-san's really something...)
(But why did she look a little sad, I wonder?)

(My homework's finally done. I'd better enjoy
what's left of summer vacation while I can.)

Oh-ho?
If it isn't \p!

Oh, Hoshimura.
What are you doing here?

Summer vacation's almost over, right?
So I figured I'd have all the fun I can,
and popped out for a spot of shopping, see.

Wow, if you're that relaxed, Hoshimura,
you must've finished your homework already.
I took you for the last-minute type.
Huh? I haven't even touched it yet.

Homework's for the last day of vacation!
Everyone knows that, right?

You're gonna be in for hell once vacation's
over... Hoshimura...

(This is the one where she doesn't finish in
time and Yamashiro-sensei chews her out...)

(My homework's finally done. I'd better enjoy
what's left of summer vacation while I can!)

Oh, Yui.
What are you doing here?

Wow, if you're that relaxed, Yui,
you must've finished your homework already.
And here I took you for the last-minute type.

You're going to be in for hell once vacation's
over... Yui...

(This is the one where she doesn't finish in
time and Yamashiro-sensei chews her out...)

(It may be for work, but I actually get to
meet the Sheryl. I can't wait!)

Oh yeah, Sheryl's concert is coming up soon.
I'd better give it my all too!

Huh? You're that fired up about it...
Hoshimura, are you a Sheryl fan?

It's not like I know nothing about her,
but I wouldn't really call myself a fan~

It's the equipment they use at the concert!
I'm just dying to know about it~

Ahh~, I wonder what cutting-edge tech
they're using~

Hey, \p...
Would I get in trouble if I took it apart
without asking, do you think?

Don't you dare take anything apart, Hoshimura.
If the concert can't start,
that'll be a huge problem...

(On the day, I'd better make sure
I don't take my eyes off Hoshimura...)

(It may be for work, but I actually get to
meet the Sheryl. I can't wait!)

Huh? You're that fired up about it...
Yui, are you a Sheryl fan?

Don't you dare take anything apart, Yui.
If the concert can't start,
it'll be a huge problem...

(On the day, I'd better make sure
I don't take my eyes off Yui...)

Woo-hoo! Yaaay~!
They found a new planet!! Yeahhh!!

Hoshimura, aren't you worried at all
about the new planet?

Nobody can tell what's gonna happen
until it happens anyway!
No use fretting over stuff like that, right?
I see... I guess you've got a point.

Yup, yup.
All we gotta do is wait and look forward to it.

(Hoshimura really is something.
Instead of worrying, I should just
look forward to it too.)

(A new planet's been found, but
I still can't help feeling uneasy...)

Yui, aren't you worried at all
about the new planet?
I see... I guess you've got a point.

(Yui really is something.
Instead of worrying, I should just
look forward to it too.)

uncertain: c19989/c19998: 'shigoto to wa ie' read as the students working at Sheryl's concert (Yui's line c19990 and the equipment talk support it); 'ano Sheryl' rendered 'the Sheryl'.
c19961: shared by both genders; 'wagamama de jishinka... ja nakute, kawaikatta no?' kept as the deliberate self-correction joke.
